meta.description: Already booked a Virgin Voyages cruise? Ask Dean to check whether your reservation or MNVV voucher can be connected to his agency.
meta.ogTitle: A helping hand for an existing booking
meta.ogDescription: Check booking-transfer eligibility with Dean. Supplier rules apply.

content.heading: Already booked? *Let’s check your options.*
content.lede: Already booked a Virgin Voyages cruise? You can request to add me as your First Mate within 30 days of the reservation’s creation, provided it hasn’t been paid in full. Contact me promptly so I can help arrange the transfer with Virgin Voyages. Have an MNVV voucher? I can help check your options for that, too.
content.checkboxLabel: I request that **Dean Satterfield (On Deck)** be assigned as my First Mate / Travel Advisor for this booking.

steps.d: Tell me about your Virgin Voyages booking or MNVV voucher.
For a Virgin Voyages reservation, I’ll check that it was created within the past 30 days and hasn’t been paid in full, then help arrange your transfer.
If the cruise line approves the transfer, I can help with your booking and requested changes. Supplier rules and fees still apply.

aside.note: Prefer to talk it through first? Reach me directly and I'll walk you through the transfer.
